bear_assumptions: USD 3.50 normalized EPS per ADS at 8x as steel pricing weakens, working capital remains elevated, Pesquería ramps slowly and Brazil, Argentina, currencies, Usiminas or litigation absorb Mexican gains.
base_assumptions: USD 5.00 normalized EPS per ADS at 10x as Mexican volumes and margins improve but remain cyclical, commissioning proceeds with normal friction, capex stays heavy and cash conversion gradually normalizes.
bull_assumptions: USD 6.50 normalized EPS per ADS at 12x as favorable pricing and import substitution persist, Pesquería commissions cleanly, customers qualify output, utilization rises and working capital releases without material balance-sheet strain.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or fresh primary evidence restores positive base and confidence-adjusted expected return, favorable bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, minimum confidence and the accepted relationship; downgrade if steel pricing, Mexican demand, commissioning, customer qualification, cash conversion, balance sheet, Usiminas, currency, litigation or trade-policy evidence deteriorates.
